implementation: SciToolFlow adaptation, not a bit-for-bit reproduction
adaptations: Use current standalone catalogue, graph and text-embedding-3-large index.
Batch/cache query and contextual embeddings; bound graph exploration.
Replace text Plan Chain/Input/FinalAnswer parsing with shared typed JSON protocol.
Use same model/client, public task inputs, formatting guide, scientific budgets and scorer as ReAct.
Replace infinite execution retry with bounded role sessions and at most three plan rounds.
Count all role generations; count automatic per-tool contract reads as discovery.

Remove the additional baseline-only safety_gate callback; use the same tool dispatcher and its validations as ReAct. Legacy graph check annotations remain historical metadata and are excluded from retrieved candidate triples.
Enforce role tool permissions in both constrained JSON and dispatch; contracts are read automatically, not rediscovered by role sessions.
Pass original public task output schema, ordered plan, plan position and observed arguments across role sessions.
Use collision-free shared embedding cache writes and at most three deadline-bound transient request attempts.
